arguments.need: I rent a few GPU boxes and want to run my own LLMs on them behind one central server that picks a free machine for each request. The GPU machines can't accept incoming connections, so they need to dial out to the server. It must expose an OpenAI-style API so my existing SDK code and n8n keep working, and I'd like per-user API keys with usage limits.
